title: The Life-Changing Manga of Tidying Up: A Magical Story
author: Marie Kondo
edition_analyzed: English-language hardcover edition published by Ten Speed Press, 2017
target_audience: Adults seeking to declutter and organize their homes
Fans of Marie Kondo and the KonMari Method
Readers interested in Japanese culture or manga
Visual learners who prefer graphic storytelling
Newcomers to decluttering and tidying philosophies
core_themes: Tidying up as a path to joy and mental clarity
Letting go of possessions that no longer ‘spark joy’
primary_purpose: To present the KonMari Method of tidying up in a story-driven, accessible manga format, guiding readers step-by-step to declutter their physical space and thereby improve their lives.

structure_format.narrative_style: Graphic novel featuring a fictional story interwoven with step-by-step instructional content
structure_format.organization: Follows the journey of Chiaki, a young woman who transforms her life with the help of Marie Kondo; breaks down the tidying process into relatable moments and practical guidance

key_concepts_lessons: Only keep items that ‘spark joy’ when touched or considered.
Tidy by category, not by location (e.g., all clothes, then all books).
The decluttering process is a one-time event, not a daily chore.
Learning to let go of excess possessions can lead to greater happiness and self-awareness.
A tidy space fosters a sense of calm, control, and optimism.
Respect for personal items and gratitude for their service.
notable_features: First manga adaptation of Marie Kondo’s bestselling philosophy
Follows a relatable character’s emotional and practical transformation
Provides concrete visual examples of before-and-after organization
Combines Japanese cultural values with universal self-help advice
cultural_historical_context: This adaptation followed the global success of Marie Kondo’s original book and reflected a wave of international interest in minimalism, Japanese lifestyle philosophies, and manga. The approachable format aimed to reach new readers and visual learners in the context of a growing global movement toward simplicity and intentional living.
reception_impact: Well-received for making the KonMari Method accessible to new and younger audiences
Praised for its charming, engaging storytelling and visual clarity
Helped internationalize the tidying movement and enhance its appeal to those intimidated by prose-heavy self-help books
Some critics note the method may not suit everyone’s lifestyle or cultural context
comparable_titles: The Life-Changing Magic of Tidying Up by Marie Kondo
Spark Joy: An Illustrated Master Class on the Art of Organizing and Tidying Up by Marie Kondo
